sources.name: Rime 袖珍简化字拼音
sources.modifications: Rime YAML rows converted to normalized TSV; lue/nue normalized to lve/nve; unsupported non-standard syllables and non-common-CJK rows rejected with a report; weights clamped to 1..1000000.

sources.name: Stage 11.5 project-authored common short sentences
sources.modifications: Project-authored source expanded with common weekday, conversation, messaging, file-sharing, people-count, device and input-method sentences; normalized and validated by the standard deterministic builder without runtime text parsing.

sources.name: Jieba Chinese segmentation frequency dictionary
sources.modifications: Common-CJK words up to 16 characters are converted to full pinyin with the pinned pypinyin 0.55.0 wheel; readings are checked against the engine syllable inventory; existing text+pinyin keys keep the established production source and frequency; frequency uses min(1000000, max(1, jieba_frequency + 1)).

sources.name: pypinyin pronunciation data and converter
sources.modifications: Unmodified pure-Python wheel is retained as a pinned, offline build input and unpacked only into a temporary directory by the importer.

sources.name: Project full-pinyin colloquial, hotword, proper-name and domain layers
sources.modifications: Project-authored sources are validated, filtered, tiered and normalized by build-quanpin-lexicon-v2.ps1; the all-domains normalized layer is the canonical production input.
